people.line: Father of Mary and maternal grandfather of Jesus.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

translations.web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
translations.bsb: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry. He was regarded as the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,
translations.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
